versions.changelog:
- Initial release of afrexai-claude-code-production v1.0.0.
- Provides a full productivity system for Claude Code: detailed project setup, prompting patterns, sub-agent orchestration, context management, and refactoring.
- Includes a CLAUDE.md architecture guide and ready-to-use templates for workflow setup.
- Offers actionable health checklists and step-by-step prompting/writeup patterns for fast, reliable coding.
- Emphasizes test-driven development, efficient context use, and parallel work via sub-agent orchestration.
- No scripts or installation required—focuses on processes and best practices to 10X code delivery speed.
